text:
sara_cs: Heads up — customer reported batch /rerank returned wildly misaligned scores for multi-query CSV import, looks like candidate lists shifted between queries. attaching sample payload and logs.

kevin_eng: oof. can you paste the exact request body they sent?

sara_cs: pasted below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "requests": [
    {"query_id": "q-101", "candidates": ["cid-a", "cid-b"]},
    {"query_id": "q-102", "candidates": ["cid-c", "cid-d"]},
    {"query_id": "q-103", "candidates": []}  
  ]
}
```
but customer said they actually submitted as newline-delimited JSON rows (CSV->JSONL exporter) and suspect our CSV import flattened a shared candidates column into one long array.

ingrid_repro: I tried reproducing on staging with their CSV and saw same symptom: the second query's candidates were the tail of the first when there are empty fields. repro steps: 1) upload CSV with empty candidate column for some rows 2) call our CSV->batch converter 3) call /rerank with resulting JSONL 4) see scores aligned to wrong queries.

samir_infra: logs from our rerank service show repeated WARN: "candidate_list_length_mismatch: expected 2 for query q-102 but found 1" then we still returned a score array of length 2 but shifted. snippet:```
[INFO] 2026-03-15T14:22:11Z request_id=xyz parse_csv: row 42 - candidates field "cid-c"
[WARN] 2026-03-15T14:22:11Z request_id=xyz candidate_list_length_mismatch query=q-102 expected=2 got=1
[ERROR] 2026-03-15T14:22:11Z request_id=xyz rerank_engine: output_scores length=3 query_count=3
```

maria_support: customer is on enterprise Dedicated; they're seeing production impact (wrong top result shown). Escalated, asking for mitigation.

kevin_eng: hypothesis: our batcher flattens candidate buffers when the input uses a shared candidates column and empty entries are serialized as empty string rather than empty array. converter treats empty as skip and we don't emit a placeholder, so indices shift.

ingrid_repro: quick confirm — if you run this curl against staging it reproduces:```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @staging_payload.json https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/rerank/batch | jq .
```
staging_payload.json is the JSONL with 3 rows where middle row candidates is an empty cell in CSV.

kevin_eng: thanks. can someone dump the pre-rerank payload the engine receives? if the batcher already has misaligned arrays, that's where to fix.

samir_infra: grabbed engine intake for request_id=xyz:```json
{
  "queries": [
    {"id": "q-101", "candidates": ["cid-a", "cid-b"]},
    {"id": "q-102", "candidates": ["cid-b"]},  <-- shifted
    {"id": "q-103", "candidates": ["cid-c", "cid-d", "cid-e"]}
  ]
}
```
so the candidate pool got concatenated and chunked incorrectly.

kevin_eng: aha. candidate pooling logic bug when merging rows with variable candidate counts. probable root cause: we use a single contiguous buffer and compute offsets using a prefix-sum derived from CSV column lengths — but empty/NULL values are treated inconsistently between parser and prefix calc.

ingrid_repro: proposed short-term mitigation: detect empty candidate fields during CSV->JSONL conversion and emit explicit empty array [] placeholders, plus a guard in the batcher to validate sum(candidates lengths) == declared total and error with 400 instead of silently shifting.

maria_support: can we offer customer a rollout plan? they need a hotfix or a workaround.

kevin_eng: workaround to give them: convert CSV into per-query JSON (no shared columns), or ensure empty cells are encoded as [] in exporter. we'll push a staging hotfix to add the guard and return 400 for mismatches.

samir_infra: I've opened infra ticket INF-3821 and pushed a staging guard: now we log and reject when derived offsets don't match candidate counts. still need code fix in batcher to handle NULLs correctly.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T16:05:12Z: staging: rerank-batcher:v2.14.1 - guard-check enabled (INF-3821).

kevin_eng: next steps: 1) fix parser to canonicalize empty candidate fields -> [] 2) add unit tests for CSV edgecases (empty, whitespace, "" strings) 3) add integration test asserting stable candidate->score alignment for multiquery batches.

ingrid_repro: I'll craft the failing CSV sample and add to our regression suite. will assign PR to @kevin_eng.

maria_support: told customer temporary workaround and ETA for hotfix; they appreciate fast response :thumbsup:.

sara_cs: thanks all — marking as P1 for Dedicated customer. I'll update the ticket with the mitigation steps and link to INF-3821.

kevin_eng: cc @samir_infra please schedule postmortem after fix.

samir_infra: will do.

maria_support: any chance this impacted hosted customers?

kevin_eng: hosted ingestion path uses different CSV converter currently, but I'll run a quick sweep for similar logic. if we find usage, we'll patch both.

ingrid_repro: last note — reproduced also when candidate column contained trailing commas ("cid-a,") from some exporters; trim logic needs to be stricter.

sara_cs: closing loop after fix verified. thank you everyone.
